content.what_it_is: Minimal MATLAB animation script (Monai Valley postprocessing): interactively prompts for a snapshot range (nstart/nend, L5-6), then for each index loads eta_XXXX and mask_XXXX ('%.4d' names) from fdir='/Users/fengyanshi/tmp3/' (L4, L14-16), NaNs dry cells (ele(mask<1)=NaN, L17), and draws pcolor with interpolated shading and colorbar (L20-21), capturing each frame with getframe into M (L23) with a 0.1 s pause. Commented movie2avi export (L26) and figure-size setup (L8).
entities: script variables: fdir @L4, nstart @L5, nend @L6, icount @L10, num @L11, fname @L14, ele @L15, mask @L16, M @L23
calls: clear all @L2; input @L5, @L6; sprintf @L14; load @L15, @L16; clf @L18; pcolor/shading interp @L20; colorbar @L21; getframe @L23; pause @L24; movie2avi (commented) @L26
unresolved: M(:,icount)=getframe(gcf) (L23) stores frame structs in a matrix column -- works only in legacy MATLAB where getframe returned a struct assignable this way; movie export path is commented (L26) so M is otherwise unused.

fdir is a hard-coded personal path (L4); snapshot numbering uses 4-digit names unlike the 5-digit names in B_01_diagnose.m -- output-naming convention differs per run configuration, not resolvable here.
